title: fix(lint): liveness author warnings and the status census read ledger rows at every depth
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBXd6krbsYu1F6K7KQHMnPe9)_

Fixes #26146

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:liveness 作者告警(`os lint`)与状态词普查,原来只读台账顶层加一层 `children`,现在读到任意深度。
- 为什么改:台账已有 41 行在第二层、2 行在第三层带 status,从未被评级;一个深层 `dead` 行或新状态词会悄悄漏过。
- 风险与回滚:今天唯一新出现的告警是仪表盘 `widgets[].chartConfig` 的 5 个已退役键(schema 本就拒收);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.ts` 的 `ledgerRows`(两处遍历共用它),再看测试文件末尾的 #26146 块。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/lint-liveness-properties.test.ts`,预期 106 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.ts`: one walk, `ledgerRows`, yields every ledger row at every depth of `children` as a dotted path, descendants before the row (the order the warn map was always filled in, so finding order at depth 0 and 1 is unchanged). `loadWarnMap` and the status census both read it, so they cannot disagree about depth again.
- The census gains a directory seam, `ledgerStatusesIn(dir)` (module export only, the same posture as `lintLivenessPropertiesFromLedgerDir`); `shippedLedgerStatuses()` is that census over the shipped directory.
- Docblocks re-measured. The `:303-306` count read "423 top-level and 285 child rows carry a status, zero grandchildren do". On `origin/main` `6390fe52` it is **528 top-level, 419 child, 41 grandchild, 2 great-grandchild**. The `WarnMap`, `loadWarnMap` and `authorWarnedProperties` docblocks now say every depth.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/lint` patch.

## Tests

- New block at the end of `lint-liveness-properties.test.ts`:
  - REAL LEDGER: `widgets.chartConfig.type` / `.xAxis` / `.yAxis` / `.series` (dead, two levels down) are in `authorWarnedProperties('dashboard')` and graded `liveness-dead-property` on an unparsed stack, through the array fan-out (the second widget authors them). The live `chartConfig.title` in the same call stays silent.
  - PLANTED: a `dead` + `authorWarn` row two levels down warns; a `planned` + `authorWarn` row three levels down warns, while its `planned` sibling without the opt-in stays silent (so the opt-in itself reaches depth 3, not only the verdict).
  - PLANTED: status words used only at depth 2 and depth 3 reach `ledgerStatusesIn`; the shipped census equals `ledgerStatusesIn(shippedLedgerDir())` and carries neither word.
- The `#16094` hint pins' `shippedRows()` / `itemAuthoring` now walk every depth, so the newly warned deep rows are held to the same "never the note, no tracker id" rule.

<details><summary>Test runs (head bec9f05846)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/lint-liveness-properties.test.ts`: Test Files 1 passed, Tests 106 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: exit 0, Test Files 165 passed, Tests 7383 passed, 5 skipped.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed: anchor 1 to 0, blob `60014c1e09ed` to `d39fa40b0098`): `ledgerRows` limited to one `children` level reds exactly the three new tests (3 failed, 103 passed). Restored: blob back to `60014c1e09ed`, equal to the `HEAD` blob, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Seat premise 6430781250 re-measured on `6390fe52`: status rows by depth 528 / 419 / 41 / 2; `authorWarn` at depth 2 or deeper: 0; the card's one-liner reads `properties` where the ledgers key `props`.
- The verdict-triggered half does reach authors: `dead` warns without an opt-in (#16094), so the 5 dead rows two levels down now warn: `dashboard` `widgets.chartConfig.type`, `.xAxis`, `.yAxis`, `.series`, `.aria`. Each is a retired key the schema already refuses, so only an unparsed stack (`os lint`) reaches the warning. No other deep row warns. Per triage 6417914269, no ledger row is regraded here.
- Serial with #26138 (draft): it edits this test file and drops rows from `app.json` / `dashboard.json`. Text-disjoint from the hunks here except that its new comment in the `dashboard silence` pin says the `chartConfig.*` rows "sit two down and were never graded", which this PR makes false; its assertions do not depend on that. Whoever lands second merges `main` and re-measures the counts above.
- The CLI's i18n walker reads `authorWarnedProperties('translation')`; the translation ledger has no warned row below the child level, so that set is unchanged.

## Verification

- 63 exit 0. Three first answered exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` on the shallow clone; `check:docs-transcript-drift` and `check:lean-entry-closure` without built `lint` / `objectql`); after `git fetch --unshallow` and `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint...' --filter '@objectstack/objectql...' build` each re-ran exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: it needs every package's `dist` (a full `pnpm build`, 88 packages absent); CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.
- `--ran` reconciliation: exit 0, "64 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 63 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED".
